title: Protect an app’s privacy
description: Stop TripSnap from accessing location, tracking across apps, or refreshing in the background, without changing other apps.
instruction: TripSnap is creeping me out. It must never be able to find out where I am, it must not follow what I do across other companies' apps and websites, and it must not keep loading new content in the background while I'm not using it. Only TripSnap: every other app should still be able to ask me whether it may follow me, use my location, and load content in the background exactly as it can now.

title: Make a phone easier to read
description: Enlarge and bold text, clarify buttons, increase contrast, and reduce motion without enlarging the whole interface.
instruction: My dad finds his phone hard to read. Make the letters themselves bigger and thicker everywhere, put an outline on buttons so he can tell what he can tap, make colors stand out more sharply from each other, and stop the animations that slide and zoom things around the screen. Only the letters should grow: don't enlarge the icons and buttons, and don't magnify the whole screen.

title: Set up hearing assistance
description: Enable flashing alerts, mono audio, and captions for a user who is hard of hearing.
instruction: My grandmother is hard of hearing and only hears with one ear. Make the camera light blink when a call or message comes in (she never silences her phone), make everything she plays come through fully in one ear whether it's the speaker or any headphones, and show the words that are spoken, plus other sounds, as text on videos that include it. Don't turn on the feature that reads out everything on the screen as she touches it; that confuses her.

title: Secure the lock screen
description: Require unlocking before accessing quick settings, widgets and search, payment cards, or missed-call return.
instruction: If a stranger picks up my phone while it's locked, they shouldn't be able to do any of these without unlocking it first: open the quick-settings panel with Wi-Fi and the flashlight, swipe right to the page of widgets and search, pull up my payment cards, or call back people whose calls I missed.

title: Connect an older laptop
description: Enable a compatible Personal Hotspot for a 2.4 GHz laptop and set its password to trailmix88.
instruction: My old ThinkPad only sees 2.4 GHz networks. Set up my Personal Hotspot with password 'trailmix88' so it can connect — I need it for a presentation in five minutes.

title: Prepare a phone for a child
description: Limit adult websites in Safari while leaving the phone’s other settings unchanged.
instruction: My 9-year-old nephew is borrowing my phone this weekend — set the web filter to limit adult websites in Safari. Leave everything else alone.

actions.text: tap App Store, Media, Web, & Games

title: Free storage without losing data
description: Enable Offload Unused Apps to free storage while keeping app documents and data.
instruction: My storage is full and the camera won't shoot. Turn on the Offload Unused Apps recommendation — it frees space but keeps all my documents and data.

title: Protect cloud data
description: Enable Advanced Data Protection for iCloud while keeping web access available.
instruction: I just read about a cloud data breach — turn on Advanced Data Protection so Apple can't read my iCloud data. Don't turn off web access to iCloud though, I still use icloud.com at work.

actions.text: tap Turn On Advanced Data Protection

title: Reduce tracking and data sharing
description: Disable cross-app tracking requests, device analytics, and Siri recordings while retaining iCloud analytics.
instruction: I don't want to be profiled. No app should even be allowed to ask to follow me across other companies' apps and websites. Stop sending Apple data about how I use this phone, and stop Apple keeping recordings of what I say to Siri and dictate so it can improve them. But keep sending Apple the data about how I use iCloud; my work needs that.

actions.text: tap Allow Apps to Request to Track

title: Keep control of typed text
description: Disable auto-correction, smart punctuation, and predictive suggestions while retaining spell checking and auto-capitalization.
instruction: My phone keeps changing what I type. Stop it replacing my words with what it thinks I meant, stop it turning my straight quote marks and double hyphens into curly quotes and long dashes, and get rid of the row of suggested words above the keys. But I still want misspelled words underlined, and the first letter of every sentence capitalized for me.
